governance_notes: This is a research-only demonstrator. It is not a clinical deployment system.
The NB3 model, preprocessor, and threshold are locked and must not be modified, refit, or retrained.
Missing patient values must never be fabricated or manually imputed for clinical interpretation.
The exact logistic coefficient contribution decomposition used for explainability is not SHAP and must never be described as SHAP.
Explanation consistency evidence (NB6) is a trustworthiness signal only, not proof of correctness, causality, clinical validity, fairness, or deployment readiness.
Population-level trust/fairness evidence (NB5) must never be presented as an individual-level guarantee.
The Safety Agent is a mandatory control point; downstream agents must not be able to override or bypass its gate.
